authority: docs/readiness/2026-09-16-slurp-next-stage-owner-decisions-v1.md owner decision 107 of 2026-09-23; coordinator ruling of 2026-09-23 (provisional decision 109): the remainder must not spend the FINAL60 reservation and must stay contact-fresh, so both reserved sets are carved out and the roster is re-frozen as a new version

carved_out_reserved_sets.authority: coordinator ruling of 2026-09-23 (provisional decision 109): the remainder must not spend the FINAL60 reservation and must stay contact-fresh, so both reserved sets are carved out and the roster is re-frozen as a new version
carved_out_reserved_sets.reading: The carve-out is exact at RECORDING granularity and is proven here and in disjointness_proof: zero carved-out recordings survive in the remainder. It is NOT exact at UTTERANCE granularity and cannot be, because devel carries several recordings of one utterance: 108 of the carved-out utterances still have sibling recordings on this roster (383 recordings). Reading them exposes the same sentence and the same gold as the reserved recordings would, through a different microphone. Deviation REM-D1 puts that residue to the owner rather than absorbing it.

completeness.statement: The expanded development read is DEV-1000 U DEV-2000-ADDED U DEVEL-REMAINDER, and with the CARVED-OUT reservations it is the COMPLETE SLURP devel split at recording granularity: 1,000 + 1,000 + 6570 + 120 = 8690 recordings, pairwise disjoint. The carved-out recordings are accounted for, not lost: they stay reserved and this roster never reads them.

dev_ladder_nesting.reading: DEV-100 and DEV-500 are exact sub-tables of DEV-1000 and DEV-500-B is an exact sub-table of DEV-2000-ADDED, so excluding the two sealed rosters excludes every rung of the DEV ladder with them; nothing else has to be subtracted.

deviations.owner_action: decide whether the utterance-level residue also has to go (that is a further 383 recordings and a third version of this roster), or accept that the reservation is enforced at recording granularity only; the counts needed for either choice are in carved_out_reserved_sets
deviations.statement: The 120 reserved recordings -- the 60 FINAL60 recordings (receipt split_role 'reserved-final-unread', held back on 2026-08-23) and the 60 historic probe-60 recordings already contacted by early probes -- are CARVED OUT of this version, so the FINAL60 reservation is not spent and no already-contacted recording is on the roster. What the carve-out cannot remove is the reserved UTTERANCES: 108 of them still have sibling recordings here (383 recordings of the same sentences through different microphones).
deviations.why_unavoidable: Arithmetic again: devel carries several recordings of one utterance, so a recording-level reservation cannot be enforced at utterance level without dropping recordings that were never reserved.

deviations.owner_action: cluster every paired analysis by utterance_id, and never report a remainder result and a DEV-1000 / DEV-2000-ADDED result as independent utterance samples
deviations.statement: 1719 of the 1827 remainder utterances already have a recording in DEV-1000 or DEV-2000-ADDED; only 108 remainder utterances were never read before, and one utterance contributes up to 59 remainder recordings.
deviations.why_unavoidable: Arithmetic: devel carries 8,690 recordings of 2,033 utterances.

deviations.owner_action: report every DEVEL-REMAINDER verdict under both natural-mixture and equal-stratum weighting, per the 2026-09-03 reporting rule
deviations.statement: No equal-per-scenario allocation is possible: the remainder is whatever the two sealed halves left, so its scenario mixture is the devel mixture minus their draws (see scenario_allocation).
deviations.why_unavoidable: Capacity, not choice; the roster is a take-all remainder.

reserved_sets_inside_the_remainder.reading: These two sets were HELD BACK by the DEV ladder, not consumed by it, so a remainder defined by subtraction alone would contain them. This version CARVES THEM OUT (see carved_out_reserved_sets): recordings_inside_the_remainder is 0 for both, so the FINAL60 reservation is not spent and no already-contacted probe-60 recording is on the roster. remainder_recordings_of_those_utterances is what a recording-level carve-out cannot remove -- sibling recordings of the same utterances -- and deviation REM-D1 puts that residue to the owner.

supersedes.reading: The parent receipt stays committed exactly as it was frozen and is NEVER rewritten: several committed documents pin its receipt_file_sha256, so adding a superseded_by key to it would break every one of those pins. The supersession is recorded here and in the preparation plan note instead.

text_disjointness.method: Digest only, after scripts/build_slurp_evo_decontamination.py and scripts/build_slurp_dev2000_roster.py: sentences are read inside one generator, compared as whole-sentence SHA-256 digests and as word 6-gram digests (rails.proposer.word_ngrams / ngram_digest), and only counts and digest-set hashes are written. No sentence and no gram is written anywhere.
text_disjointness.reading: Construction pools are TRAIN-only by loader construction, so the id-level proof is structural; these counts say how much of the remainder's TEXT a TRAIN-built knowledge store could already contain, measured against the sealed DEV-1000 half under the identical method.

utterance_overlap.reading: devel carries 8,690 recordings of 2,033 utterances, so utterance-level disjointness from the two sealed halves is arithmetically impossible for a remainder that must cover the whole split. These counts are the exact size of the sharing; see deviation REM-D2 for what an analysis has to do about it.
